summary: We are the Saint Andrews Episcopal Middle School Model UN. Model UN engages thousands of students every year in a fun political simulation of how a UN general assembly might proceed. It teaches very valuable life skills, such as persuasive talking, formal debate, public speaking, diplomacy, and researching skills, while uniting delegates in a fostering learning environment. Many of today's world leaders, whether in government, buisness, or the actual UN, have participated in MUN.
